meta.notes: Measured target height and source/runtime form behavior only; timing/completion/motion/simplicity are omitted UNKNOWN. Diagnostic44px target threshold is not WCAG2.2 AA target minimum.

gate_results.title: Single dominant primary CTA
gate_results.fix: Keep one dominant primary action and demote secondary actions.

gate_results.title: Critical touch targets >= 44px
gate_results.fix: Increase hit area (padding/wrapper) for critical controls.

gate_results.title: Primary completion action at task endpoint
gate_results.evidence: Completion action aligns with task endpoint.
gate_results.fix: Place submit/continue where user naturally finishes the task.

gate_results.title: Choice density <= 7 visible options
gate_results.fix: Reduce options and defer advanced paths with progressive disclosure.

gate_results.title: Progress visible on multi-step flows
gate_results.fix: Add stepper/progress bar/counter for staged tasks.

gate_results.title: Interaction feedback <= 400ms p95
gate_results.fix: Show immediate pressed/loading feedback and reduce response latency.

gate_results.title: Validation rules visible with inline recovery
gate_results.evidence: Validation guidance is hidden or vague.
gate_results.fix: Show requirements before submit and field-level actionable errors.

gate_results.title: Input tolerance and normalization
gate_results.fix: Accept common formats and normalize internally.

gate_results.title: Critical actions are at list/menu boundaries
gate_results.fix: Move high-priority actions to beginning or end positions.

gate_results.title: Explicit positive ending/closure
gate_results.fix: Add success/failure confirmation and next-step guidance.

principle_results.name: Fitts's Law
principle_results.mechanism: Movement time is shaped by target distance and size.
principle_results.requirement: Critical actions must be large and easy to reach.
principle_results.signal: Target size and reachability improve hit accuracy and speed.
principle_results.fix: Increase target size/padding and move high-value actions closer to task endpoints.

principle_results.name: Hick's Law
principle_results.mechanism: Decision time rises as visible choices increase.
principle_results.requirement: Limit concurrent choices and defer advanced options.
principle_results.signal: Lower first-action latency and reduced decision stall.
principle_results.fix: Reduce choice density and introduce progressive disclosure.

principle_results.name: Gestalt: Proximity
principle_results.mechanism: Spatial closeness signals conceptual grouping.
principle_results.requirement: Related items stay close, unrelated groups stay apart.
principle_results.signal: Fewer label-field association errors.
principle_results.fix: Increase intra-group cohesion and inter-group separation.

principle_results.name: Gestalt: Similarity
principle_results.mechanism: Shared appearance implies shared function.
principle_results.requirement: Same component role must keep consistent styling.
principle_results.signal: Reduced functional misclassification.
principle_results.fix: Unify role-based tokens for color, shape, and typography.

principle_results.name: Gestalt: Continuity
principle_results.mechanism: Eyes follow uninterrupted visual paths.
principle_results.requirement: Flow and continuation cues should be explicit.
principle_results.signal: Better discovery of next steps and off-screen content.
principle_results.fix: Align paths and expose continuation hints (peeking cards, steppers).

principle_results.name: Gestalt: Closure
principle_results.mechanism: Users mentally complete incomplete shapes/structures.
principle_results.requirement: Partial visual structures must remain interpretable.
principle_results.signal: Cleaner UI with intact comprehension.
principle_results.fix: Use simplified structure only when completion remains obvious.

principle_results.name: Gestalt: Figure/Ground
principle_results.mechanism: Attention depends on clear foreground/background separation.
principle_results.requirement: Focus context should dominate via layering and contrast.
principle_results.signal: Lower context-loss in modal/sheet flows.
principle_results.fix: Strengthen scrim/layer contrast and focus hierarchy.

principle_results.name: Gestalt: Common Fate
principle_results.mechanism: Synchronized motion implies grouping.
principle_results.requirement: Related elements should animate in coordinated direction/timing.
principle_results.signal: Improved grouping comprehension in motion states.
principle_results.fix: Unify motion curves/directions for grouped elements.

principle_results.name: Gestalt: Focal Point
principle_results.mechanism: Contrast directs first attention.
principle_results.requirement: Each screen should have one dominant attention anchor.
principle_results.signal: Higher primary action discoverability.
principle_results.fix: Converge to one visual priority and demote competing accents.

principle_results.name: Von Restorff Effect
principle_results.mechanism: Distinct items are more memorable than uniform items.
principle_results.requirement: Isolate one key action/info node from a stable baseline.
principle_results.signal: Higher recall and click concentration on key target.
principle_results.fix: Use selective contrast for one key choice, not all choices.

principle_results.name: Jakob's Law
principle_results.mechanism: Users expect familiar interaction patterns from prior products.
principle_results.requirement: Trust-critical flows should follow established conventions.
principle_results.signal: Lower navigation and auth confusion.
principle_results.fix: Align navigation/search/auth/checkout patterns with common standards.

principle_results.name: Miller's Law
principle_results.mechanism: Working memory handles limited chunks concurrently.
principle_results.requirement: Chunk content and stage long tasks.
principle_results.signal: Improved completion on long forms and flows.
principle_results.fix: Split dense screens into smaller chunked steps.

principle_results.name: Goal-Gradient Hypothesis
principle_results.mechanism: Motivation rises as users approach completion.
principle_results.requirement: Progress and milestones should remain visible.
principle_results.signal: Completion acceleration in later steps.
principle_results.fix: Expose progress counters and milestone reinforcement.

principle_results.name: Zeigarnik Effect
principle_results.diagnosis: No clear resume path for interrupted tasks.
principle_results.mechanism: Incomplete tasks persist in memory and drive return behavior.
principle_results.requirement: Unfinished states must be visible with a resume path.
principle_results.signal: Higher interrupted-flow recovery.
principle_results.fix: Expose completion status and one-click resume mechanisms.

principle_results.name: Tesler's Law
principle_results.mechanism: Complexity cannot be removed, only redistributed.
principle_results.requirement: System should absorb complexity from users.
principle_results.signal: Lower entry friction and cleaner structured data.
principle_results.fix: Use smart defaults, autocomplete, masks, and structured controls.

principle_results.name: Peak-End Rule
principle_results.mechanism: Users remember the peak and the ending disproportionately.
principle_results.requirement: Final states should be explicit and confidence-building.
principle_results.signal: Higher satisfaction and reduced uncertainty after submit.
principle_results.fix: Add clear success/failure closure with next-step guidance.

principle_results.name: Postel's Law
principle_results.mechanism: Robust systems accept varied input but emit consistent output.
principle_results.requirement: Input parsing should tolerate common human variations.
principle_results.signal: Fewer avoidable validation dead-ends.
principle_results.fix: Support tolerant parsing and provide precise recovery guidance.

principle_results.name: Doherty Threshold
principle_results.mechanism: Fast feedback preserves cognitive flow and productivity.
principle_results.requirement: Interactions should acknowledge user intent rapidly.
principle_results.signal: Reduced duplicate taps and waiting confusion.
principle_results.fix: Provide immediate visual acknowledgment and optimize perceived speed.

principle_results.name: Serial Position Effect
principle_results.mechanism: First and last sequence items are recalled best.
principle_results.requirement: Place critical actions/info at sequence boundaries.
principle_results.signal: Higher discovery/recall of key actions.
principle_results.fix: Move top-priority actions to start/end positions.

principle_results.name: Occam's Razor
principle_results.mechanism: Simpler sufficient solutions reduce cognitive load.
principle_results.requirement: Remove non-essential UI and interaction burden.
principle_results.signal: Faster task completion and fewer distractions.
principle_results.fix: Trim unnecessary states/features and simplify task path.

principle_results.name: Parkinson's Law
principle_results.mechanism: Work expands without explicit constraints.
principle_results.requirement: Guard against feature creep in delivery scope.
principle_results.signal: Lean implementation aligned to user goal.
principle_results.fix: Enforce MVP boundaries and defer non-critical additions.
